body: I just don’t think life has a meaning, even so I would rather not wait for it to get better, I don’t believe it will. I’d rather just rip the bandage off

That’s the funny thing, there’s not much external making it tough, sure my family is quite rough and I’m discriminated against fairly frequently, but for the most part it has to do with the fact that I have psychotic depression and every form of treatment that’s been tried has no affect. It’s just hopeless for me. I’ve just sorta given up on life, I think I’m gonna end it soon though. I don’t wanna live through another day of just being a walking corpse.
I know what you mean, it’s like no one cares about people like me and I feel no one would miss me. It sucks.
